questions.question: A circular flower bed has a radius of 7 feet. What is its area? (Use π ≈ 3.14.)
A bicycle wheel has a diameter of 28 inches. Approximately how far does the wheel travel in one complete revolution? (Use π ≈ 3.14.)
questions.explanation: One revolution covers the circumference: C = πd = 3.14 × 28 = 87.92 inches.

questions.question: The circumference of a circular fountain is 62.8 meters. What is its radius? (Use π ≈ 3.14.)
A circular table has an area of 314 square inches. Approximately what is the radius of the table? (Use π ≈ 3.14.)
A circular running track has a radius of 35 meters. About how far does a runner travel after running halfway around the track? (Use π ≈ 3.14.)
questions.explanation: Halfway around is half the circumference. C = 2πr = 2 × 3.14 × 35 = 219.8 meters. Half of that is 109.9 meters.
